Subject: Vendor onboarding — tax docs / EIN discrepancy

Hi Marissa / Ben / Grace,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. We're ready to move Redwood Inference into our vendor master and issue PO NW-7124, but our onboarding system flagged a tax ID mismatch on the entity name provided. To clear the hold we need:

- Completed W-9 (signed) or W-8BEN-E if not US-resident
- Copy of the EIN confirmation letter (IRS CP 575 or equivalent)
- A bank letter for ACH setup (simple PDF is fine)
- Remittance address and contact for invoices

I've attached the vendor onboarding form that our procurement team prefers (Northwind_VendorOnboardForm.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood will provide a W-9 or if you expect to submit a W-8BEN-E?

If it's easier we can accept DocuSign for the W-9; our AP team will process the PO activation once the tax docs and bank letter are validated.

Thanks,
Elaine

Quick answers and next steps so we can activate PO NW-7124 by tomorrow morning:

- Company history: Redwood Inference, Inc. has been the legal name since incorporation (2019). We have never filed as an LLC; the mismatch your system saw is likely due to a legacy vendor record that combined multiple related entities at Northwind.
- Evidence: attached is our EIN confirmation extract and a brief attestation below. If you need a notarized affidavit we can provide one, but this should be sufficient for AP processing.

Attestation (signed by CFO on company letterhead): "Redwood Inference, Inc. confirms its legal name and EIN (82-3141592) are accurate for vendor payments and tax reporting. Redwood Inference has not filed federal tax returns under the name 'Redwood Inference LLC'."

I have uploaded the W-9 and bank letter to your DocuSign envelope per Ben's link and added the attestation to Jira PROC-4821 (link above). Please confirm once your AP team flips the status to "Vendor Verified" so we can see PO auto-release.

If anything else is required for compliance (e.g., copy of previous 1099 filings), flag it here and we'll get it over.
